description: PAID $0.002 USDC. CPM, CPC, CTR by ad platform (meta, google_search, google_display, tiktok, linkedin) and industry, each figure with source report, URL and as-of date. Optional platform, industry, metric. Returns JSON CPM, CPC, and CTR figures, each with the source report, URL, and as-of date.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

industry.description: Optional industry name. Format: plain words. Example: real estate. Omit for every industry.

metric.description: Optional single metric. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: cpm. Omit for CPM, CPC, and CTR. Allowed values: cpm, cpc, ctr.

platform.description: Optional ad platform. Format: a platform slug. The tool text names meta, google_search, google_display, tiktok, and linkedin. Example: meta. Omit for every platform.
